create_quaternet_model: create a QuaterNet model with a given number of skeleton joints for 3D pose estimation
run_quaternet_forward_pass: run a forward pass of QuaterNet on input tensors to predict joint rotations as quaternions
build_quaternet_with_controls: build a QuaterNet model with extra control features for conditioned motion generation
test_quaternet_velocity_mode: test QuaterNet in velocity mode to model relative rotations instead of absolute poses
review_quaternet_forward_return_all: review the QuaterNet forward method return_all option to output all frames instead of the last
